subject: Recap + MPA: QuantumX discovery — milestones, owners, and approval path
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@quantumx.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@quantumx.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-12-02T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Recap + MPA: QuantumX discovery — milestones, owners, and approval path

Hi Sanjay / Elaine —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we have a single picture of milestones, owners, and the procurement checkpoints that matter to your team. Please confirm any corrections and the dates that are feasible on your side.

Top pain and goals I heard:
- Latency variability on current LLM endpoints causing degraded user experience during peak queries (esp. session re-use flow).
- High per-token cost on tail queries (longer context) — want predictable unit economics.
- Requirement: private deployment option (VPC) and audit logs for HIPAA-ish workflows.

Goals you shared:
1) Proof-of-concept within 6 weeks to validate latency SLOs and cost delta vs current provider.
2) Security evidence (SOC2 summary + KMS integration) for procurement review.
3) Procurement decision and pilot purchase by end of Jan 2029.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level) — draft attached: 
- Milestone A (Week 0–2): Tech deep-dive + baseline profiling
  - Owner: QuantumX (Sanjay) / Redwood (Alex)
  - Deliverable: baseline p95/p99 profiles, token-cost estimate for 3 workloads
  - Target date: 2028-12-14

- Milestone B (Week 2–5): Pilot deploy (Dedicated or Private)
  - Owner: Redwood (Ben) / QuantumX infra (Elaine)
  - Deliverable: pilot environment, sample traffic, latency runbook
  - Target date: 2029-01-09

- Milestone C (Week 5–8): Security & procurement pack
  - Owner: QuantumX procurement (TBD) / Redwood security (Laura)
  - Deliverable: SOC2 evidence, KMS integration notes, contract draft
  - Target date: 2029-01-23

Key risks / asks from Redwood:
- Access: temporary staging keys + sample traffic that reproduces the p99 spikes.
- Decision path: who signs procurement? any legal playbook we should expect?
- Data: confirm whether you need on-prem support or VPC-only is ok.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the Milestone owners and the target dates above (reply with any updates).
2) Schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive with your infra and app owners (I included two suggested time slots in the attached Doodle).
3) Ben will send a tailored pricing/quote and a pilot SOW once we lock the scope.

Attachments: quantumx-mpa-draft-20281202.pdf (MPA table + timeline), redwood-pricing-quote-std-2028.pdf (baseline pricing, pilot options).

If that aligns, I’ll queue the tech deep-dive for early next week and Ben will start the quote.

—Alex
Alex Martinez | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@quantumx.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@quantumx.ai>
Date: 2028-12-02T17:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + MPA: QuantumX discovery — milestones, owners, and approval path

Alex — thanks for the clear summary and the draft MPA. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Owners:
- Tech deep-dive owner will be me (Sanjay) and I’ll invite our lead infra (Elaine) plus one of our ML engineers (Rajesh).
- Procurement will be handled by our vendor manager, Fiona Hale (fiona.hale@quantumx.ai) — she’s currently OOO until 12/11 but will be the approver.

2) Timeline tweaks:
- We can do the tech deep-dive on 2028-12-06 or 2028-12-07; either morning PT works.
- Pilot deploy: we need the pilot window to be 2028-12-18 to 2029-01-08 (slightly earlier than your target) because of a product freeze the week of 1/9.
- Procurement decision: target is 2029-01-26 (we need 3 business days buffer for legal review).

3) Security:
- We need a short write-up (1–2 pages) describing your KMS flow, where keys are stored, and the audit log retention — Laura at Redwood + your Security lead can coordinate.

We’re attaching our internal pilot checklist (we’ll send after you confirm) and I’ve requested Elaine to share the baseline traces that reproduce the p99 spikes.

If you can update the MPA with the revised dates/owners I outlined, we’ll confirm and lock the tech deep-dive slot.

Thanks —
Sanjay Rao
Head of Platform Engineering, QuantumX
sanjay@quantumx.ai | +1 (650) 555-6678

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@quantumx.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@quantumx.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Fiona Hale <fiona.hale@quantumx.ai>
Date: 2028-12-03T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + MPA: QuantumX discovery — milestones, owners, and approval path

Sanjay/Team — great, thanks for the quick responses and the timeline clarifications. I updated the attached MPA to reflect:
- Tech deep-dive on 2028-12-07 @ 10:00am PT (calendar invite to follow).
- Pilot window 2028-12-18 -> 2029-01-08 (we’ll prioritize low-latency routing and KV cache tuning).
- Procurement target 2029-01-26 with legal review buffer.

Action items I’m picking up now:
- Ben will finalize a pilot SOW and a tailored quote (including an option for Redwood Private with KMS integration).
- Laura (cc’d) will start assembling the SOC2 and KMS notes for your security pack — Laura, I’ll DM the checklist we use for private deployments.
- I’ll share the pilot runbook and a short doc that shows how we instrument prefix/KV caching to reduce token cost.

Ben — can you please attach the pilot SOW draft and the quote by EOD 12/03 so we can get Fiona looped in for the procurement window?

Sanjay — thanks for flagging Fiona; I added her to the thread so she sees the updated MPA. If anyone needs the MPA in a different format (spreadsheet vs PDF) tell me and I’ll send it.

Cheers,
—Alex

Attachments: quantumx-mpa-draft-20281202.pdf (updated), redwood-pricing-quote-std-2028.pdf
